metadata.source: Visa Onchain Analytics, Brevan Howard, a16z State of Crypto, Nacha/FedACH
metadata.note: Gross volume from on-chain data. Commercial estimate filtered per METHODOLOGY.md. ACH from Nacha quarterly reports. All values in USD billions.

milestones.note: THE SIGNAL. Settlement rail competition begins. Contested since 2026-10-15: the curated series crossed 1% in 2024-12, but the McKinsey x Artemis payment-only measure implies ~0.45% of ACH for 2025-12. See cross_checks.
Banks and payment processors materially impacted

cross_checks.source: McKinsey & Company x Artemis Analytics, "Stablecoins in payments: What the raw transaction numbers miss"
cross_checks.period_note: McKinsey reports $390B for 2025, computed from activity data as of December 2025 against a $35T annualized gross. It is read here as a December 2025 annualized run rate; if it is instead the full-year total, the 2025 average is the same $32.5B/month and ~0.46% of ACH, so the milestone reading does not change.
cross_checks.comparison: Same included categories as the curated commercial estimate (B2B, P2P, P2M, payroll, remittance). The curated series shows $120B for 2025-12, about 3.7x this measure.
cross_checks.note: Payment-only measure that excludes trading, internal transfers, arbitrage and smart-contract loops. Monthly run-rate reported at roughly $30B in early 2026, up from $5B in January 2024.

filtering_note: Commercial volume is estimated by excluding known DeFi protocol interactions, exchange-to-exchange transfers, arbitrage activity, and same-entity treasury management. This is a best-effort approximation. See METHODOLOGY.md for full filtering methodology.
